author: cursor
original: 测试辅助函数 startDialogTitleText 只读取 lines[1]，标题被 ansi.Wrap 折行时只比较第一行。这会单向削弱 TestStartDialogTitleFollowsPhase 中的否定断言（如「读取中标题不得包含 tui.start_confirm」）：若未来某语言的确认问句折到第二行，断言会在标题实际仍显示确认问句时静默通过。当前 startTestApp 使用 size() 的默认宽度 80，五种标题均不折行，因此现有断言全部成立，影响仅限后续文案或宽度变化。最小改法：让该 helper 从 lines[1] 起收集到含 '─' 的分隔行之前的所有行并拼接后再比较。
basis: Independently verified against start_async_test.go:283-290 and start_dialog.go:87: the helper reads only lines[1]. Title assertions that use this helper run at size() default width 80; Width is set to 12 only after those assertions (start_async_test.go:271). At width 80 the five titles are single-line. Wrap and overflow are covered by the Width=12 loop that inspects every popup line, not this helper. ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA do not require the helper to join wrapped title rows. This is optional future-proofing of a test helper, beyond this card's contract, and is not a defect in the current delivery.
